name: extra/php-typeerror-into-outfile
reason: PHP: IntoKeyword::parseFileOptions() receives a null keyword (`INTO OUTFILE '...' f`, a non-keyword after the file name) and throws a TypeError under strict_types, i.e. phpMyAdmin answers with a fatal error. The port passes the null through, records no exception and keeps parsing (MySQL then reports the syntax error).
